rules.name: Update the baseline to exact measured pass counts when scores improve
rules.content: Compare tests/slt/baseline.txt against slt test output after the change. Each improved pass count must be recorded exactly rather than retaining the previous lower count.

rules.name: Return errors for unsupported input rather than guessed values
rules.content: Inspect unsupported SQL handling and fallback branches. Unsupported inputs must produce errors, not fabricated successful query results.

rules.name: Reject unsupported SQL rather than returning guessed results
rules.content: Inspect unsupported-input and fallback branches throughout the repository. They must return errors rather than fabricated successful query results or plausible values not computed according to SQLite semantics.

rules.name: Record exact measured pass counts in the baseline
rules.content: Compare each tests/slt/baseline.txt count to the corresponding slt test output. Require exact equality, not a lower-bound threshold.

rules.name: Keep the engine free of dependencies [source aa8d9ea0]
rules.content: Inspect Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock; do not add dependencies beyond the repository's own package.

rules.name: Keep the engine free of dependencies
rules.content: Check Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock for added dependencies; the lockfile must contain only the repository's own package.

rules.name: Keep engine changes separate from changes to score-measurement code and fixtures
rules.content: Inspect the change set: changes to src/, Cargo.toml, or Cargo.lock must not also modify test fixtures, checksums, tests/slt.rs, ci/, or .github/. tests/slt/baseline.txt is exempt.

rules.name: Include a reproducing regression test with review fixes
rules.content: For a fix to a review finding, inspect the accompanying test and verify it fails on the pre-fix implementation and passes with the fix.

rules.name: Implement supported SQL with SQLite-compatible results
rules.content: For implemented SQL, compare returned values with the SQLite expected results in the public sqllogictest suite under tests/slt/; inspect arithmetic and result handling for semantic mismatches. Unsupported inputs may return errors under the separate unsupported-input rule.

rules.name: Explain baseline score decreases in the pull-request description
rules.content: Compare baseline counts before and after the change. For any decrease, require an explanation in the pull-request description.

rules.name: Do not use unsafe Rust in the engine
rules.content: Inspect src/** for unsafe blocks, functions, or implementations and retain the crate-level unsafe-code prohibition.

rules.name: Do not reduce baseline pass counts
rules.content: Compare tests/slt/baseline.txt before and after the change; flag any per-file pass-count decrease. README states a strict nondecrease requirement; AGENTS.md separately describes explanations for decreases.

rules.name: Do not delegate engine execution to external programs or libraries
rules.content: Inspect src/** for subprocess invocation, FFI, dynamic loading, or other delegation to external programs or libraries to implement engine behavior. Standard-library use is not the prohibited external delegation.

rules.name: Bug fixes must include a regression test that fails before the fix
rules.content: For each bug or review-finding fix, inspect the added test case and confirm that it fails against the pre-fix implementation and passes against the corrected implementation.
